svg.title: A prescribed flow changes a well-mixed washout curve
svg.desc: Original exact exponential washout curves for a constant 100 mL compartment with balanced inflow/outflow at 25, 50, and 100 mL/s. Spatial velocity, clots, and stroke risk are not predicted.
